spans.s:
तगडवल्ली तगड-वल्ली, f. (तगड = तगर),
the shrub Cassia Auriculata.

तगर तगर, अम्, n. the shrub Tabernæ-
montana Coronaria and a fragrant^1 powder prepared
from it; N. of a town; (अस्), m. a thorny shrub,
Vangueria Spinosa; another plant, commonly Taga-
[]
ra-mūla; [cf. काल-पर्ण, कटु-च्छद, मदन-
वृक्ष.]
—तगर-पादिका, अम्, f. n. or तगर-
पादी, f. the plant Tabernæmontana Coronaria and
its powder.
—तगर-शिखिन्, ई, m., N. of a man.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.
तगरिक, अस्, ई, m. f. a seller of Tagara powder.
